Why virtual tours work in Yelahanka

Yelahanka and the stretch towards Devanahalli attract weekend travellers, wedding families, corporate offsite planners and home buyers — almost all of them coming from elsewhere in Bangalore or beyond. None of them wants a long drive just to see whether a place is right.

A 360° tour of a resort’s rooms and lawns, a venue’s hall or a villa’s interiors helps them shortlist confidently from home.

Large properties and outdoor spaces

Resorts and venues are captured around bookings and occupancy, often over a full day for larger properties. Outdoor lawns and pools are shot when the light is at its best.

Frequently asked questions — Yelahanka

Do you shoot 360° virtual tours in Yelahanka?

Yes. Thamco360’s scan crew travels to businesses and properties across Bangalore, including Yelahanka, and deploys within 48 hours of booking. There is no studio to visit — the crew comes to you.

Can you shoot a large resort near Yelahanka in one day?

A boutique property is usually covered in a day. Larger resorts with many villas and outdoor areas can take one to two days, scheduled around guest occupancy.

Do you travel to venues beyond Yelahanka, towards Devanahalli?

Yes. The crew travels to properties across north Bangalore and around the airport, and travel is planned into the quote.

How much does a 360° virtual tour cost in Yelahanka?

Basic Thamco360 packages start from just ₹7,999. The final price depends on the size of the space, the number of scan points and any extras such as a website embed or custom 3D features.
